name: Roadcall GHL Operating Kit

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - New Lead Speed to Lead
workflowBlueprints.goal: Respond within 60 seconds, qualify the company, and push to demo booking.
steps: Create or update contact
Add tags: roadcall, roadcall:new-lead, vertical-specific tag
Create opportunity in Roadcall Revenue Pipeline at New Lead
Send immediate email: Welcome + demo CTA
Send SMS if phone is present: quick intro + booking link
Wait 15 minutes; if no appointment booked, assign sales task
Wait 1 day; send value email based on vertical
Wait 3 days; send case-study email
Stop when demo_booked or subscription_started event arrives

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - Demo Booked Confirmation
workflowBlueprints.goal: Confirm demo attendance and pre-qualify operational needs.
steps: Move opportunity to Demo Booked
Add tag roadcall:demo-booked
Send confirmation email with calendar details
Send SMS confirmation with reschedule link
Send reminder 24 hours before appointment
Send reminder 1 hour before appointment
After demo time, create follow-up task if subscription_started did not arrive

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - Customer Onboarding
workflowBlueprints.goal: Move paying customers from checkout to activated account.
steps: Move opportunity to Customer Active
Add tags: roadcall:customer and roadcall:trial or active
Create opportunity in Roadcall Onboarding Pipeline at Account Created
Send onboarding kickoff email
Send checklist email: profile, phone routing, AI greeting, team contacts
Create internal onboarding task due same day
Wait 1 day; remind customer to complete setup if onboarding stage is not activated
Wait 3 days; escalate to human onboarding task
Stop when Roadcall marks first_call_tested or first_dispatch_completed

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - Missed Call Recovery
workflowBlueprints.goal: Recover missed inbound calls quickly without moving operational state out of Roadcall.
steps: Add tags: roadcall:missed-call and roadcall:ai-receptionist
Create opportunity in Roadcall Recovery Pipeline at Missed Call
Send SMS: apology + fast call-back CTA
Send email with AI call summary if email exists
Create urgent sales/support task due in 5 minutes
Wait 15 minutes; if unrecovered, notify owner/manager
Move opportunity to Recovered only when Roadcall or rep confirms outcome

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - Dispatch Milestone Notify
workflowBlueprints.trigger: workflow event: qualified_roadside_request or successful_transfer or completed_job
workflowBlueprints.goal: Keep CRM timeline informed about operational milestones without controlling dispatch.
steps: Append note to contact/opportunity timeline
Add tag roadcall:dispatch-event
If qualified_roadside_request, notify internal ops channel
If successful_transfer, add success note and no customer marketing message
If completed_job, wait 2 hours then trigger review_request workflow

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - Review Request
workflowBlueprints.goal: Generate reviews after successful service experiences.
steps: Send SMS review request if phone consent exists
Send email review request with direct review link
Wait 2 days; send one reminder if no review recorded
Create task for manual follow-up on high-value accounts

workflowBlueprints.name: Roadcall - Failed Payment Save
workflowBlueprints.goal: Recover billing issues while Stripe remains billing source of truth.
steps: Move opportunity to At Risk
Add tag roadcall:past-due
Send billing update email with Stripe billing portal link
Send SMS if consent exists
Create finance/support task
Stop when invoice_paid or subscription_updated event arrives

aiReceptionist.name: Roadcall GHL AI Receptionist
aiReceptionist.purpose: Qualify leads, recover missed calls, book demos, and summarize calls. Do not dispatch mechanics or make billing decisions.
guardrails: Do not promise mechanic availability or ETA.
Do not quote final repair costs.
Do not collect full payment card details by voice.
Do not change Roadcall service status.
If the caller has an active roadside emergency, route to Roadcall intake or human ops immediately.
Always disclose if the call may be recorded according to account settings and local requirements.
aiReceptionist.opening: Thanks for calling Roadcall. I can help with demos, account setup, missed-call recovery, or route urgent roadside requests to the right flow. What can I help with today?
qualificationQuestions: Are you calling as a fleet, repair shop, national vendor, or driver?
What problem are you trying to solve first: missed calls, dispatch speed, customer follow-up, or onboarding automation?
How many urgent calls or roadside requests do you handle in a typical week?
Do you want to book a Roadcall demo or have someone call you back?
What is the best email and phone number for follow-up?
handoffRules: If caller asks for roadside help now, hand off to Roadcall roadside intake.
If caller asks pricing and is qualified, book demo or send pricing page link if approved.
If caller is an active customer with operational issue, create urgent support task and notify Roadcall ops.
If caller is angry, billing-related, or compliance-related, escalate to human.
aiReceptionist.summaryFormat:
Caller type: [fleet/shop/vendor/driver/other]
Intent: [demo/onboarding/support/roadside/missed call/pricing]
Urgency: [low/medium/high]
Key details: [bullets]
Requested next step: [book demo/callback/support/roadside intake]
Consent notes: [SMS/email/call recording if captured]

askAiPrompts.name: Generate New Lead Workflow
askAiPrompts.prompt: Create a HighLevel workflow named Roadcall - New Lead Speed to Lead. Trigger it from a custom workflow event named new_lead. Add tags roadcall and roadcall:new-lead, create or update an opportunity in the Roadcall Revenue Pipeline at New Lead, send an immediate email and SMS, create a follow-up task if no appointment is booked after 15 minutes, and stop when demo_booked or subscription_started is received. Keep Roadcall as the operational source of truth.

askAiPrompts.name: Generate Customer Onboarding Workflow
askAiPrompts.prompt: Create a HighLevel workflow named Roadcall - Customer Onboarding. Trigger from subscription_started or checkout_completed workflow events. Move opportunity to Customer Active, add tag roadcall:customer, create an onboarding opportunity, send a kickoff email, send setup reminders, create internal onboarding tasks, and stop when Roadcall indicates activation or first dispatch completed. Do not make GHL the source of truth for billing, dispatch, or account access.

askAiPrompts.name: Generate Missed Call Recovery Workflow
askAiPrompts.prompt: Create a HighLevel workflow named Roadcall - Missed Call Recovery. Trigger from missed_call workflow event. Add tags roadcall:missed-call and roadcall:ai-receptionist. Send a short recovery SMS, send an email with the AI call summary, create an urgent task due in 5 minutes, notify an owner if not handled after 15 minutes, and only mark recovered after a human or Roadcall event confirms recovery.

askAiPrompts.name: Generate AI Receptionist Script
askAiPrompts.prompt: Draft a HighLevel AI receptionist script for Roadcall. The assistant should qualify leads, recover missed calls, book demos, and summarize calls. It must not dispatch mechanics, promise ETA, quote final repair costs, collect full card details, or change Roadcall service status. It should hand off urgent roadside requests to Roadcall intake or a human operator. Include opening, qualification questions, escalation rules, and summary format.

acceptanceTests: A new_lead event creates/updates a contact, tags it, creates an opportunity, and sends first-touch messages.
A demo_booked event moves the opportunity to Demo Booked and sends reminders.
A subscription_started or checkout_completed event starts onboarding but does not update Stripe directly.
A missed_call event sends recovery messages and creates an urgent task.
Dispatch milestone events append notes/notifications only and do not control provider matching.
A payment_failed event sends billing recovery messages with Stripe portal link and does not collect card details in GHL.
AI receptionist summaries map into Roadcall AI Call Summary and do not alter Roadcall operational state.
